test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "surprised."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use **"surprised" **in the blank is to convey the notion that the listener could potentially feel unexpected or astonished upon learning about the variety of houses. (रिक्त स्थान में **"suprised"** का उपयोग करने का कारण यह धारणा व्यक्त करना है कि घरों की विविधता के बारे में जानने पर श्रोता संभावित रूप से अप्रत्याशित या आश्चर्यचकित महसूस कर सकते हैं।)
 
• Using** "surprised" **in this context implies that the speaker believes the listener may not have anticipated the extent or diversity of houses, and the information might cause them to feel a sense of surprise or wonder.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct paragraph**:

Do you live in a house? You might be **surprised**__ to learn that there are many, many kinds of ______ (2) ______. Most people in the United States are used to live in houses made of wood or bricks. But many people around the world live in houses made of grass, dirt, or cloth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Socked: **to hit someone with your fist. (किसी को अपनी मुट्ठी से मारना)
 
• **Calculable: **able to be measured or assessed. (मापने या मूल्यांकन करने में सक्षम)
 
• **Certain: **completely sure; without any doubts. (पूर्णतया आश्‍वस्‍त; संदेह से मुक्त, असंदिग्‍ध)
